title: Tetracycline antibiotics: mode of action, applications, molecular biology, and epidemiology of bacterial resistance

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Tetracycline antibiotics: mode of action, applications, molecular biology, and epidemiology of bacterial resistance》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Tetracyclines were discovered in the 1940s and exhibited activity against a wide range of microorganisms including gram-positive and gram-negative bacteria, chlamydiae, mycoplasmas, rickettsiae, and protozoan parasites.
